description: Player auto-switches to fullscreen on rotate to landscape and shows the command panel on rotate to portrait, without interrupting playback, in both the standalone and stream players

name: Streams settings now offer a default sort order, a default media-type filter, a
description: Streams settings now offer a default sort order, a default media-type filter, a channel-list refresh policy, and a clear-play-marks action; the Streams screen remembers the last search and filter on reopen.

name: Compact context-aware playback control dialog
description: Playback control dialog: context-aware tabs (3D only on VR builds; audio/subtitle tabs hidden when not selectable), distinct Volume vs Audio track tabs, quick speed presets 0.5x/1.5x/2x, compact height

name: Play MediaProjection capture suite
description: Ships the Play-safe screenshot suite on standard: take a screenshot through per-session system consent, then copy it to the clipboard, open it in the drawing editor, run on-device OCR-translate, send it via Send To, and save it to a configured or fallback folder.

name: Channel favicon thumbnails in the stream catalog
description: Each stream-catalog row shows a recognizable per-channel favicon thumbnail sliced from a single sprite-atlas PNG bundled inside the downloadable catalog archive (offline-built from each channel homepage); channels without a favicon show an empty slot. The atlas and its coordinate column are backward-compatible - older app versions ignore them without crashing.

name: Actionable streams-catalog empty state
description: When the streams catalog has no sources, the empty state shows an icon plus inline Add-stream and Import-list buttons that open the same dialogs as the toolbar actions, so recovery is one tap instead of finding the toolbar glyphs.

name: Stream browser grid mode: live channels shown as tiles with a captured current f
description: Stream browser grid mode: live channels shown as tiles with a captured current frame, list/grid toggle persisted across sessions, snapshot-and-release capture with concurrency limit and TTL cache

name: Edge-gesture action: crop screenshot and share
description: A left-edge gesture action that captures the screen, immediately reopens the screenshot with a draggable crop frame, overwrites it with the cropped result, then opens the app Send to menu (print, social, email) targeting the cropped image.

name: Select resource entry
description: Send-to menu ends with a permanent 'Select resource..' entry that copies the current file to a destination resource (or a custom folder via '..') from the player and all standalone players, mirroring the file browser Copy-to dialog.

name: Crop tool in the draw editor
description: Crop the working image to a draggable rectangle inside the draw editor - full resolution for local files - then keep annotating before saving or sharing.

name: Stream wait-phase label: buffering vs reconnecting
description: While a network stream is loading, the player shows a caption under the spinner that tells the user which wait is happening: buffering (filling the memory buffer) or reconnecting (re-establishing a dropped connection). Localized in English, Russian and Ukrainian. The stream buffer is also tuned for steadier playback on an unstable connection without regressing live-edge tracking.

name: Bandwidth-adaptive stream buffer
description: The internet-stream player sizes its playback buffer to the measured connection speed at runtime: on a weak or unstable link it builds a deeper cushion so a stream rides out throughput dips instead of stalling into the loading spinner, and on a healthy link it stays modest. Live HLS/DASH streams keep their live-safe buffer depth so they still track the live edge without falling behind.

name: Re-tap to stop an inline stream
description: Tapping a stream that is already playing inline stops it, so one gesture both starts and stops playback.

name: Duplicate parenthetical title suppression
description: Stream titles of the form Name (Name) render as Name; a differing parenthetical (region/quality) is kept.

name: Multi-column stream list in landscape
description: The stream list shows two or more columns in landscape and recomputes the column count on rotation.

name: Fullscreen stream video player
description: Opening a video stream goes straight to immersive fullscreen; a surface tap reveals the top command bar and bottom controls without the media players touch zones.

name: Long-press to pin a stream
description: Long-pressing a stream row or tile pins or unpins it to the top of the list.

name: Pinned-only stream filter
description: The stream filter can limit the list to streams the user pinned.

name: Remembered stream filter and sort
description: The chosen stream filter, media kind, sort, and search query are restored on the next launch.

name: Remembered stream list position
description: The stream list returns to the same item the user last viewed after a restart.

name: Stream health probe on refresh
description: The refresh action checks each visible stream for reachability and marks it green or red, refreshing grid thumbnails, and stops on any user interaction.

name: Grid tile status dot and overflow menu
description: Grid tiles show a play-status dot in the lower-left corner and a three-dot command menu in the upper-right corner.

name: Landscape-style layout now triggers by minimum available width (>=600dp) in addi
description: Landscape-style layout now triggers by minimum available width (>=600dp) in addition to landscape orientation, so wide high-resolution devices held in portrait get the wide layout instead of collapsing content to the top-left.

name: Offline stream play soft-fail
description: Streams refuse to play with a quick no-network message instead of spinning when the device has no Wi-Fi or mobile data.

name: Standard edge-gesture and tile capture triggers
description: On the standard Play flavor, screen capture can be triggered from the edge-gesture family - an opt-in edge strip (specialUse FGS) with configurable directional capture/share actions and an app-launch panel, plus a Quick Settings tile fallback that captures via MediaProjection consent without a persistent overlay. Both triggers ship gated off by default, enabled per build pending Play review of the specialUse declaration.

name: Show the left-edge gesture strip
description: An option in the left-edge gesture settings shows a semi-transparent grey guide only on the first 4 px of the otherwise-transparent gesture strip, leaving the rest invisible; default off, and the change applies to the live strip immediately while the gesture overlay is enabled.

name: Database reset recovery notice
description: When the local database cannot be opened or migrated, the app backs up the existing database files and shows a dialog explaining the reset and where the backup was saved, instead of silently wiping data.

name: Static analysis gate (detekt + ktlint)
description: Developer-facing detekt plus ktlint formatting gate over app_v2 and wear Kotlin sources with frozen ratchet baselines; runs locally and via post-change.ps1, failing only on new findings. Separate from the runtime build (not wired into assemble).

name: Listener symmetry ratchet gate
description: Developer-facing lexical gate over app_v2 and wear Kotlin sources that freezes the current register/unregister and add/remove Listener/Callback/Observer imbalance, then fails only on new drift. Runs directly via script and from post-change.ps1 on Kotlin or Mixed changes.

name: Camera zoom presets, zoom slider & night mode
description: In-app camera: zoom presets 0.5-30x with a draggable zoom slider, overlay controls legible on any background, and a device-gated photo night mode.

name: Listener symmetry ratchet gate
description: Developer-facing cheap lexical check verifying matching register/unregister and add/remove listener calls, integrated into post-change.ps1 with a ratchet baseline.

name: Architectural custom Lint rules module
description: Custom Android Lint rules module (:lint-rules) with AST detectors validating Activity logic delegation, UI context leak prevention, repeatOnLifecycle Flow usage, player resource release, and main-thread I/O checks.

name: Instrumented memory leak detection
description: On-demand instrumented leak detection runner using LeakCanary inside instrumented tests to verify UI flow lifecycle and fail on leak detection.

name: Quick Launch Panel in programs menu
description: The Quick Launch Panel can now be opened from the main window programs (three-dots) menu, in addition to the edge gesture, Quick Settings tile, and widget.

name: Exit button minimizes when background functions are active
description: The top-left exit button minimizes the app (keeping background music, recording, scheduled file operations and the edge-gesture overlay alive) instead of closing it whenever any such function is active; it fully closes only when nothing runs in the background, and a long-press always force-closes after a brief 'background stopped' toast.

name: Stream country metadata with filter and sort
description: Shows each catalog channel's country as a flag+code chip before the language chip in the stream list, and lets you filter and sort the stream list by country. The country comes from the curated catalog (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code); channels without a known country stay visible and sort last.

name: Photo GPS geotagging (opt-in)
description: Optionally embeds the device GPS location in the EXIF of photos taken with the in-app camera. Opt-in via Operations > Camera (off by default), requests location permission on enable, and never blocks the shutter when no fix or permission is available. Works for full-frame and digital-zoom shots and for camera launches from widgets.

name: Programs panel on the main window
description: Optional horizontal panel mirroring the programs three-dots menu above the resource list; icons in portrait, icons plus labels in landscape, overflow for items that do not fit; hides the three-dots button while shown. Default off.

name: Streams panel on the main window
description: Optional horizontal panel above the resource list with a Streams entry button followed by pinned channels in pin order; channel chips show a favicon thumbnail and/or a short name chosen by window width; tapping a channel plays it. Default off, requires Streams enabled.

name: Context menu on main-window panel items
description: Each item on the main-window programs and streams panels has a three-dots button (when labels show) or long-press menu to open it, open it in a separate window when multi-window is available, or remove it from the panel - disabling the program in settings, or unpinning the channel. Body tap still opens or plays the item directly.

name: Fixed camera controls, Send To and settings dialog
description: In-app camera keeps controls physically fixed while icons rotate, shows the active save destination, adds a Send To action for the latest capture, and exposes capability-driven settings such as timer, grid, aspect ratio, resolution, exposure, white balance, manual ISO/shutter and HDR when supported.

name: Screen video recording from the programs block: whole-screen MediaProjection cap
description: Screen video recording from the programs block: whole-screen MediaProjection capture with microphone audio via a foreground service, pause/resume and stop from a compact in-app indicator (shared with quick voice capture) or the notification, saved to the chosen resource or Downloads.

name: Persistent last-frame stream thumbnails
description: Grid mode saves each captured live video-stream frame to app-private storage and re-shows it as the channel thumbnail on next launch, so a known http(s) video channel appears with its last frame immediately instead of a blank/favicon tile, then refreshes to a live frame.

name: Context icons on Settings and Welcome
description: Settings collapsible group headers and feature toggle rows, plus the Welcome functionality and network pages, show a monochrome icon of the matching feature (images, video, audio, documents, streams, network sources, file browser, calculator, capture, mic and screen recording, OCR, translation, gestures, scheduled operations) to the left of the label, so features stay recognisable when labels are small.

name: Inline audio playback from the main-window streams panel
description: Tapping an audio (radio) channel on the main-window streams panel plays it inline in the home window with a bottom now-playing bar (channel name, ICY track, stop button), without opening the streams list screen; re-tapping the same channel stops it. Video channels still open the streams screen.

name: Configure shortcut in main-window panel menus
description: Long-press menus of the main-window programs panel and the streams entry button include a Configure item that opens Settings directly on the relevant group with that section expanded and scrolled into view.

name: Collapse resource-type filter strip
description: Long-press the main-window resource-type tabs to collapse them into a colored label strip; tap the strip to expand. The collapsed state persists across app restarts.

name: Hide the main-window streams panel from its entry menu
description: Long-pressing the main-window Streams panel entry button now offers a 'Hide panel' action that hides only the panel while keeping Streams enabled, so the Streams button returns to the programs panel/menu. It is distinct from 'Disable', which turns the whole Streams feature off; re-enable the panel via Settings -> Streams.

name: Add live channels to Favorites
description: Add a live channel to the shared Favorites list (when Favorites is enabled); it shows by channel name and opens in the stream player, independent of pinning.

name: Country flag fallback in streams list
description: Shows the channel country flag in the streams-list leading icon slot when the channel has no favicon atlas tile, keeping row alignment

name: Take a photo (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that captures a photo headlessly - no camera screen opens - and saves it to the device camera folder with a confirming toast. Only the system camera-in-use indicator appears briefly; a fully silent capture is not possible on Android.

name: Take a photo and send to.. (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then opens it in the standalone viewer with the send-to menu.

name: Take a photo and edit (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then opens it directly in the draw/edit tools.

name: Take a photo and OCR-translate (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then runs OCR-translate on it. Hidden when the translation capability is not available.

name: Start video recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that opens the camera fixed in video mode, ready to record; the clip saves to the public Movies folder.

name: Start audio recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that starts the quick voice recorder; repeating the gesture stops and saves the recording.

name: Start screen recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that starts screen video recording via the app disclosure plus the system MediaProjection consent; repeating the gesture stops and saves. Hidden on flavors without the capture engine.

name: Open app settings from the browse menu
description: The file browser overflow menu has a bottom-pinned 'App settings' entry that opens the main Settings window directly, without returning to the home screen.

name: Mini-game visual modes
description: Switchable visual skins for the mini-game: Classic (abstract shapes) and Kryvavitsa (light-gray field, black walls, human silhouettes, a door exit and stomping movement). The chosen mode persists across launches and the help legend follows the active mode.

name: Programs panel header menu
description: The main-window programs panel starts with a three-dots header button opening a panel menu: Configure panel (jumps to the Additional programs and scenarios settings), Collapse panel (folds the row into a labelled strip that a tap re-expands; the collapsed state persists across restarts), and Hide panel (removes the panel and restores the three-dots button in the top command bar).

name: Streams panel collapse
description: The main-window streams panel entry button long-press menu gains a Collapse panel item that folds the panel into a labelled Streams.. strip; a tap on the strip re-expands it, and the collapsed state persists across restarts.

name: Camera scenario context label
description: The in-app camera shows a context label naming the current scenario (text recognition) above the zoom presets so the user remembers why the camera was opened; hidden for generic capture.

name: Collapsed panels grouped in one row
description: Collapsed main-window panels (programs / streams / resource-type filter) group their labels as compact chips in one shared row above the resource list instead of separate full-width strips; tapping a chip expands that panel back to its place, and an empty row takes no vertical space.

name: Long-press name labels
description: Long-pressing a main-window element reveals its name: the programs-item / streams-entry / channel context menus gain a greyed non-clickable name header at the top, and the icon-only top command-bar buttons show their name via a tooltip - making icon-only controls understandable.

name: Travelling D-pad / TV focus frame
description: A single highlighted frame follows keyboard, D-pad and gamepad focus across every screen, form and dialog so the focused item is always visible; it shows only under remote/gamepad control, not touch. In the player, arrows move focus between the on-screen transport controls.

name: Macrobenchmark, Baseline Profile and Perfetto perf harness
description: Developer-facing macrobenchmark, baseline profile and Perfetto workflow for the standard flavor: stable local commands measure cold start, browse/player readiness and back-navigation, and the same journeys generate a baseline profile for release builds.

name: Network video playback keeps thumbnail suspension until playback truly ends - a
description: Network video playback keeps thumbnail suspension until playback truly ends - a stale 300ms resume job no longer clears the active flag mid-stream, so previews are not wrongly marked as permanently failed

name: Double-tapping the same inline audio stream during the service connect no longer
description: Double-tapping the same inline audio stream during the service connect no longer leaves an orphaned background player - a stale play callback now stops the just-started player instead of resurrecting it

name: Standalone document viewer no longer leaks a PdfRenderer, file descriptor or Web
description: Standalone document viewer no longer leaks a PdfRenderer, file descriptor or WebView when paging between mixed-type documents (PDF/EPUB/Office) - teardown now releases every initialized viewer, not just the active type

name: Read Aloud (TTS) no longer keeps playing or leaks its engine when the player scr
description: Read Aloud (TTS) no longer keeps playing or leaks its engine when the player screen is recreated (theme/font change or 'Don't keep activities'); TTS state updates are now confined to the main thread

name: The deprecated standalone player no longer crashes on teardown when launched wit
description: The deprecated standalone player no longer crashes on teardown when launched with a default-player probe URI or destroyed on the first frame - the view-manager release is now guarded against an uninitialized state

name: Open video files in fullscreen mode
description: Video files opened from Browse can launch straight into fullscreen playback, controlled by a new Video Settings toggle - on by default for every device profile except Audio Player and E-book Reader.

name: Player settings dialog redesigned to canonical header/actions layout - title no
description: Player settings dialog redesigned to canonical header/actions layout - title no longer wraps in portrait

name: Enable-all onboarding: OCR/translation toggles no longer silently revert when bo
description: Enable-all onboarding: OCR/translation toggles no longer silently revert when both engine installs complete near-simultaneously (serialized settings writers)

name: Browser sign-in: saving an account no longer risks a crash when the screen rotat
description: Browser sign-in: saving an account no longer risks a crash when the screen rotates while the session is being stored

name: Network folders (SMB): connection-degradation recovery reacts on time under para
description: Network folders (SMB): connection-degradation recovery reacts on time under parallel load (timeout strike counting no longer loses events)

name: Standalone player: manual pause survives background/resume, SAF rename no longer
description: Standalone player: manual pause survives background/resume, SAF rename no longer restarts playback from 0

name: Background/inline audio (slideshow music, Browse mic/inline audio, Streams OFF-m
description: Background/inline audio (slideshow music, Browse mic/inline audio, Streams OFF-mode, wear) now correctly requests and abandons audio focus - ducks/pauses for other apps, survives split-screen multi-window instead of stopping when one window closes

name: Player subsystem correctness fixes: BD-TS local video now uses the tuned playbac
description: Player subsystem correctness fixes: BD-TS local video now uses the tuned playback pipeline, Now Playing sheet stops polling when backgrounded, VR launch no longer crashes on a settings-write hiccup, stream error-recovery no longer disturbs the next file's position

name: Colour-coded main-window panels
description: Each collapsible main-window panel (programs, streams, resource-type filter) has its own accent background shown in both expanded and collapsed state, with a recognisable icon on the collapsed chip.

name: App panel: quick camera, voice, screen recording, and link download
description: The quick-launch app panel can now also hold quick camera capture, quick voice recording, screen recording, and download-by-link - the same functions already available from the main window's Programs and Scenarios menu - each gated by the same build/runtime rules as its main-window counterpart.

name: Floating stop indicator for quick audio recording
description: Quick audio recording started from the home widget or an edge gesture shows a small floating indicator with a Stop control on top of whatever app is open, in addition to the existing notification and repeat-gesture ways to stop it.

name: Settings - Management - Destinations: confirm-delete and confirm-move toggles no
description: Settings - Management - Destinations: confirm-delete and confirm-move toggles now render as two full-width rows in portrait instead of squeezed side-by-side columns

name: Settings > Management > OS Interaction: system-media-handler and accept-shared-f
description: Settings > Management > OS Interaction: system-media-handler and accept-shared-files toggles stack in two full-width rows in portrait; unchanged in landscape

name: Reorder pinned streams
description: Reorder pinned streams (move up / down / to top) from the streams list and grid three-dot menu; order honoured by the main-window panel and channel selection.

name: App-wide focus indicator for remote/D-pad
description: On devices without touch, the currently focused control is highlighted with an accent outline drawn in place on the control itself, shown app-wide only in non-touch (remote/keyboard/gamepad) mode.

name: Automatic initial focus on every screen
description: On devices without touch, opening any screen places focus on a real control automatically, so the first remote/D-pad key acts immediately instead of being spent waking focus.

name: Standalone document viewer: tap a PDF hyperlink to open it, long-press to select
description: Standalone document viewer: tap a PDF hyperlink to open it, long-press to select page text; legacy player pages PDFs with a vertical swipe.

name: More OS settings tiles in the quick-launch panel
description: The quick-launch panel Android settings catalog adds Developer options, Battery saver, Auto-rotate, Accessibility, Wireless networks, Data usage, NFC and VPN tiles; each appears only when its settings screen resolves on the device.

name: Quick-launch panel pickers (app / feature / OS shortcut / resource) now show a s
description: Quick-launch panel pickers (app / feature / OS shortcut / resource) now show a search-filter for long lists and a consistent single-choice UI with leading icons.

name: VR install CTA no longer appears on the vr flavor when opening 3D content (it wr
description: VR install CTA no longer appears on the vr flavor when opening 3D content (it wrongly prompted to install the VR edition while already running it).

name: OCR and DTS native modules are now bundled in the APK, so they work on Google Pl
description: OCR and DTS native modules are now bundled in the APK, so they work on Google Play standard installs instead of showing a misleading 'delivered via Google Play' unavailable message.

name: Audio-related permissions are no longer silently disabled on minified release bu
description: Audio-related permissions are no longer silently disabled on minified release builds (the flavor gate used reflection that R8 broke); the gate now resolves BuildConfig flags directly.

name: Camera/video gesture actions as panel functions
description: The quick-access (app-launch) panel function picker now offers the camera/video actions from the left-edge gestures: take a photo and send-to, take a photo and edit, take a photo and OCR-translate, and start a video recording.

name: Quick-launch panel close button
description: The quick-launch panel dialog shows an explicit close (X) button before the title, so it can be dismissed with a tap in addition to Back or tapping outside.

name: Windows companion one-action SFTP import
description: Imports a .fmscfg config exported by the FastMediaSorter Windows companion (folder-share helper): one file pick creates ready-to-use read-only SFTP resources per shared folder with the embedded credential and TOFU-pinned host key - no manual host/port/key entry.

name: Viber receiver
description: Shares one file to the installed Viber app and falls back to the system chooser if direct dispatch is unavailable.

name: Messenger receiver
description: Shares one file to the installed Messenger app and falls back to the system chooser if direct dispatch is unavailable.

name: Short-video social receiver
description: Shares one image, GIF, or video to an installed compatible short-video social app and uses the first file from a multi-selection.

name: Share SFTP resource access as a file
description: Exports a chosen SFTP resource to a .fmscfg config file (optional password omission, private-network reachability warning) and hands it to the system share sheet for Telegram or email.

name: One-tap import of a shared SFTP access file
description: Tapping a received .fmscfg attachment from Telegram or email opens a confirm dialog (with a password field when the file carries none) and creates the ready-to-use SFTP resource.

name: Companion QR scan import
description: Scans a companion QR code with the camera to add the shared PC folders as read-only SFTP resources in one step with no file; decodes both plain and compressed payloads through the shared parser and TOFU host-key pin; scan entry point hidden on camera-less and VR devices.
